sd.note: Hardware is expected to pass here where the emulator cannot. That asymmetry is the point of the check, not a failure.

audio.note: Audibility is a human-only judgement; the emulator can only say the stream ran without underruns.

correlation.note: Any disagreement is recorded even if hardware passes. An emulator that says pass where hardware says fail is the failure mode this project exists to prevent; the reverse (emulator cannot judge, hardware passes) is a known gap, not a defect.
